confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough aggregates from search snippets (Numbeo Catania data, a 2026 nightlife guide, blogs and menus), not full page reads, and several sources are undated or cached. Restaurant meal anchors are firmest. Beer assumes a 0.4 to 0.5 liter draught. Cocktail and wine-glass values rest on a few spritz, bar and menu price points and were checked against the local beer relationship. Accommodation is a holistic July high-season estimate with no booking pages or listings inspected. Euro prices were converted at an assumed EUR/USD of about 1.15, not a retrieved rate. The FX figure is the RBA's 18 November 2026 observation as reported in a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Restaurant and drink levels are benchmarked to Numbeo's Catania comparisons, which put Catania close to Palermo, Siracusa and Bari and below Rome, Barcelona and Cagliari on restaurant meals. Hostel and hotel tiers are holistic estimates for a mid-sized Sicilian tourist city in July, not derived from comparable-city listings.
